page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. The instance features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The processor includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of L3 cache, with hardware support for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512_VNNI), AES cryptography, and BMI2 instructions.

This server type does not include any bundled local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The absence of integrated local storage and dedicated GPU hardware limits its direct applicability for workloads requiring high-speed local scratch space or hardware-accelerated graphics and deep learning training.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple tests. It achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1287.0 and a multi-core score of 11107.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 29517.51. In memory bandwidth testing, it records 1705.41 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Database operations score 11442.59 on Passmark, and Redis SET operations reach 28.91 million operations per second. For lightweight machine learning, the instance processes 135M model prompts at 1539.55 tokens per second and 7B model prompts at 45.98 tokens per second. These metrics indicate suitability for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a general-purpose, x86_64 architecture server instance configured with 32 dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY vCPUs operating at 3.1 GHz and 128.0 GB of RAM. The hardware features 32 physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, 35 MB of L3 cache, and support for AVX-512 vector instructions. It lacks built-in local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Benchmark results show average-tier performance, including a Passmark CPU score of 29517.51, a Redis SET throughput of 28.91 million operations per second, and a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec. This resource profile is suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, static web serving, and database operations that do not require local NVMe storage.
